title: Cubic Linear Solver Work Bound
statement:
Let $
u$ be a finite, decidable-equality, encodable set, and let a finite list of linear equations over $\mathbb F_2$ in variables indexed by $
u$ be given. The work of the cubic linear solver on this list is at most $|
u|\,m\,(|
u|+2)+|
u|\,(|
u|+1)$, where $m$ is the number of equations in the list.
hypotheses_covered: The input is a list of linear equations over $\mathbb F_2$ indexed by $\nu$
